I’ve subsequently spoken to 14 different Sky advisers, so I’ve had more than enough opportunities for Sky to help. 27 years as a customer — and this is how Sky treats its customers

The issue isn’t that I cannot understand the arithmetic. It’s that I dispute the underlying charges, payment allocations, dates and balances that Sky has used to arrive at its figure.

reviews.title: Disappointing delivery communication and customer service
reviews.text:
I ordered an iPhone 18 Pro Max 512GB in Burgundy from Sky Mobile on 13 September. On 20 September, I contacted customer service and was specifically told by an agent that my phone would be delivered on Friday 25 September.

I contacted Sky again on 24 September to confirm the delivery, only to be told that they could not confirm it, had no information showing it would arrive tomorrow, and that the delivery could take longer.

The biggest issue is the conflicting information. If Sky cannot confirm a delivery date, customers should not be given a specific date and then be left without any clear update. I have now lost confidence in the information I am being given and have decided to cancel my order.

Sky needs to improve its order tracking and communication between customer service and customers. A clear and accurate delivery update would have avoided this whole situation.

⭐☆☆☆☆ 1/5  
My broadband has been down for an extended period due to an Openreach outage, and the support I received from Sky has been extremely disappointing.  The live chat agents were polite, but completely unable to provide any meaningful help. I was repeatedly told to call a support number, despite explaining several times that the IVR system was breaking up and impossible to understand. The only advice I received was to “try again later” or use another device, even though I had already explained this issue had been happening for days.  What frustrated me most was the complete lack of accountability. No clear explanation was given regarding what work had actually been carried out, no realistic timeframe for repair was provided, and almost every response ended with “it’s beyond our control.”  I rely on internet service for my work as a streamer/content creator, regularly streaming to hundreds of viewers. Because of this outage, I had to temporarily move elsewhere and pay additional rent just to continue working. Despite explaining the impact this situation had on my income and work, I still received only generic scripted responses and apologies instead of actual solutions.  The live chat felt pointless:  * unable to resolve the issue, * unable to escalate effectively, * and unable to provide accurate updates.
